D: A mercenary turned disfigured antihero hunts the man who ruined his face.
P: Serve the chimichangas whenever Deadpool mentions them.
S: Corn chips under warm cheddar cheese sauce with pickled jalapeños
Corn chips with a hot cheese sauce of cheddar melted into evaporated milk with jalapeño juice, pickled jalapeños on top.
Crunchy baked caramel popcorn with chili powder, lime zest and salt

Popcorn coated in a crunchy brown sugar caramel with lime zest, chilli and salt, baked until it snaps, served in striped paper bags. Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil and spread on 2 lined trays. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 60g golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb, 1 tsp chilli powder, the zest of 2 limes and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, then cool and break up.
the taxi driver who becomes his sidekick

Crisp pastry triangles filled with spiced potato, peas, cumin seed, ginger and green chilli, fried until blistered, with tamarind and mint chutneys. Boil 600g potatoes, peel and dice. Fry 1 tsp cumin seeds in oil, add 1 tbsp grated ginger and 1 chopped green chilli, then the potatoes, 100g frozen peas, 1 tsp garam masala, coriander and salt, and cool. Cut 6 sheets of spring roll pastry into strips, fold into cones, fill and seal with flour paste. Fry at 175C for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with tamarind chutney and mint yoghurt.
M: Fried flour tortillas packed with chipotle beef, black beans and cheddar
Flour tortillas filled with shredded beef braised with chipotle, cumin and onion, plus beans and cheese, folded tight, fried at 180C until crisp. Sour cream, guacamole and salsa.
Blind Al's crispy beef and kimchi tacos
dinner with his flatmate Blind Al

Smoky spiced beef mince in shells fried crisp to order, loaded with kimchi slaw, cheddar, pickled onion, sour cream and hot salsa, Seoul-meets-LA street style. Brown 600g beef mince with 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 150ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Fold 12 corn tortillas in half and shallow fry in hot oil for 1 minute a side until crisp. Quick-pickle a sliced red onion in lime juice and salt. Toss shredded iceberg with 100g chopped kimchi. Fill the shells with beef, kimchi slaw, cheddar, onion, sour cream and salsa.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with rainbow buttercream swirls
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, piped with buttercream striped in rainbow colours inside the bag, finished with a little gold fondant horn on each.
K: Tequila, orange liqueur and fresh lime shaken hard, salted rim, makes four
45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime shaken hard with ice, strained into a glass with a salted rim.

s.note: Corn chips under warm cheddar cheese sauce with pickled jalapeños
s.how: Warm 375ml evaporated milk until steaming and stir in 250g grated cheddar until smooth. Add 2 tbsp pickled jalapeño juice. Pour over a 300g bag of corn chips and scatter with pickled jalapeños.

s.note: Crunchy baked caramel popcorn with chili powder, lime zest and salt
s.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil and spread on 2 lined trays. Boil 150g brown sugar, 80g butter and 60g golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb, 1 tsp chilli powder, the zest of 2 limes and 1 tsp salt. Pour over the popcorn and toss well. Bake at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes, then cool and break up.

m.note: Fried flour tortillas packed with chipotle beef, black beans and cheddar
m.how: Braise 800g beef chuck with an onion, 2 chipotles in adobo and 1 tsp cumin for 3 hours, then shred. Fill 8 flour tortillas with beef, a tin of black beans and 150g cheddar. Fold tight and fry at 180C until crisp. Serve with sour cream, guacamole and salsa.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with rainbow buttercream swirls
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar, split and colour, then pipe in rainbow stripes. Add a small gold fondant horn to each.

d.note: Tequila, orange liqueur and fresh lime shaken hard, salted rim, makes four
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 20ml orange liqueur and 25ml fresh lime juice hard with ice. Strain into a glass with a salted rim. Makes four.
